sections.markdown:
# Exchange queue metrics: ingest validation
Run the sections top to bottom after the install. Allow 2 to 3 minutes after the first task run.

- **Section 2**: every `custom.exchange.*` metric key the tenant has received. Compare with the metrics table in `exchange/README.md`.
- **Sections 3 and 4**: data points per metric in the last 15 minutes (about 15 is healthy, `last_success` should be 1). A 0 in a `db_*` column is normal on a non-mailbox server.
- **Sections 5 to 7**: collector health over time, queue depth and service states.
- **Sections 8 and 9**: submission performance counters over time, and Exchange services that are installed but not running (all 34 monitored services).
- **Sections 10 to 14**: dimension checks. Every dimension from the extension (`exchange.server`, `exchange.environment`, `queue.identity`, `next_hop_domain`, `mail_path`, `database.copy`, `database.name`, `database.status`, ...) should be filled in. A `null` or `0` in these tables means the dimension is missing.
- **Sections 16 to 22**: mailbox size and activity (optional, installer switch `-IncludeMailboxStats`). These metrics refresh every 30 minutes, so the queries look back 2 hours. Skip them if you did not install the mailbox task.

input.value:
metrics from: now() - 1h
| filter startsWith(metric.key, "custom.exchange.")
| summarize count(), by: {metric.key}
| sort metric.key

sections.title: Data points: collector health and queues

input.value:
timeseries {
  success      = max(custom.exchange.collector.success),
  duration     = max(custom.exchange.collector.duration_ms),
  queueCount   = max(custom.exchange.queue.count),
  totalMsgs    = max(custom.exchange.queue.total_messages),
  poison       = max(custom.exchange.queue.poison.length),
  submission   = max(custom.exchange.queue.submission.length),
  mailboxDeliv = max(custom.exchange.queue.active.mailbox.length)
}, by: {exchange.server}, from: now() - 15m, interval: 1m
| fieldsAdd last_success = arrayLast(success),
            success_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(success)),
            duration_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(duration)),
            queueCount_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(queueCount)),
            totalMsgs_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(totalMsgs)),
            poison_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(poison)),
            submission_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(submission)),
            mailboxDeliv_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(mailboxDeliv))
| fields exchange.server, last_success, success_pts, duration_pts, queueCount_pts, totalMsgs_pts,
         poison_pts, submission_pts, mailboxDeliv_pts

sections.title: Data points: databases, submission counters, services (0 = counter absent on this server)

input.value:
timeseries {
  copyQueue   = max(custom.exchange.database.copy_queue_length),
  replayQueue = max(custom.exchange.database.replay_queue_length),
  mounted     = max(custom.exchange.database.mounted),
  subOk       = max(custom.exchange.submission.successful.persec),
  subTempFail = max(custom.exchange.submission.temp_failures.persec),
  subFailed   = max(custom.exchange.submission.failed.persec),
  subPending  = max(custom.exchange.is.messages_queued_for_submission),
  subHubRetry = max(custom.exchange.submission.hub_servers_in_retry),
  svcRunning  = max(custom.exchange.service.running),
  svcPresent  = max(custom.exchange.service.present)
}, by: {exchange.server}, from: now() - 15m, interval: 1m
| fieldsAdd copyQueue_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(copyQueue)),
            replayQueue_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(replayQueue)),
            mounted_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(mounted)),
            subOk_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(subOk)),
            subTempFail_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(subTempFail)),
            subFailed_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(subFailed)),
            subPending_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(subPending)),
            subHubRetry_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(subHubRetry)),
            svcRunning_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(svcRunning)),
            svcPresent_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(svcPresent))
| fields exchange.server, copyQueue_pts, replayQueue_pts, mounted_pts, subOk_pts, subTempFail_pts, subFailed_pts, subPending_pts, subHubRetry_pts, svcRunning_pts, svcPresent_pts
timeseries success = max(custom.exchange.collector.success), by: {exchange.server}, from: now() - 1h, interval: 1m

sections.title: Messages per queue (only non-empty queues with -ExcludeEmpty)

input.value: timeseries messages = max(custom.exchange.queue.message_count), by: {exchange.server, queue.identity}, from: now() - 1h, interval: 1m

timeseries running = min(custom.exchange.service.running, scalar: true), by: {exchange.server, service}, from: now() - 15m
| sort running asc, service asc

sections.markdown:
## Dimension checks
Each query groups by the dimensions the extension defines. Compare the output with `exchange/README.md`. Queue and database tables are empty on servers that have no queues or databases.

sections.title: Queue dimensions: series with each dimension filled in

input.value:
timeseries messages = max(custom.exchange.queue.message_count, scalar: true),
  by: {exchange.server, exchange.environment, queue.identity, delivery_type, status, next_hop_domain, next_hop_category, mail_path},
  from: now() - 15m
| summarize series = count(),
    exchange_server = countIf(isNotNull(exchange.server)),
    exchange_environment = countIf(isNotNull(exchange.environment)),
    queue_identity = countIf(isNotNull(queue.identity)),
    delivery_type = countIf(isNotNull(delivery_type)),
    status = countIf(isNotNull(status)),
    next_hop_domain = countIf(isNotNull(next_hop_domain)),
    next_hop_category = countIf(isNotNull(next_hop_category)),
    mail_path = countIf(isNotNull(mail_path))

timeseries messages = sum(custom.exchange.queue.message_count, scalar: true),
  by: {exchange.server, mail_path, queue.identity, next_hop_domain, delivery_type, status},
  from: now() - 15m
| sort mail_path asc, messages desc

sections.title: environment on every metric family (expect one row: onprem, all counts above 0)

input.value:
timeseries {
  collector = max(custom.exchange.collector.success),
  queueCount = max(custom.exchange.queue.count),
  queueMsgs = max(custom.exchange.queue.message_count),
  poison = max(custom.exchange.queue.poison.length),
  hybrid = max(custom.exchange.hybrid.outbound.message_count),
  dbMounted = max(custom.exchange.database.mounted),
  subOk = max(custom.exchange.submission.successful.persec),
  isQueued = max(custom.exchange.is.messages_queued_for_submission),
  svc = max(custom.exchange.service.running),
  net = max(custom.exchange.cluster.network.up)
}, by: {exchange.environment}, from: now() - 15m, interval: 1m
| fieldsAdd collector_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(collector)),
            queueCount_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(queueCount)),
            queueMsgs_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(queueMsgs)),
            poison_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(poison)),
            hybrid_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(hybrid)),
            dbMounted_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(dbMounted)),
            subOk_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(subOk)),
            isQueued_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(isQueued)),
            svc_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(svc)),
            net_pts = arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(net))
| fields exchange.environment, collector_pts, queueCount_pts, queueMsgs_pts, poison_pts, hybrid_pts, dbMounted_pts, subOk_pts, isQueued_pts, svc_pts, net_pts

sections.markdown:
## Mailbox metrics (optional)
Sent by `Send-ExchangeMailboxMetrics.ps1`: the top 50 mailboxes by size per server, plus a total per database. Allow up to 30 to 40 minutes after the install for the second run, and use the 2 hour window below. Mailbox display names are stored in the `mailbox.name` dimension.

sections.title: Mailbox dimensions: series with each dimension filled in (every count should equal series)

input.value:
timeseries size = max(custom.exchange.mailbox.total_item_size_bytes, scalar: true),
  by: {exchange.server, environment, mailbox.name, database.name}, from: now() - 2h
| summarize series = count(),
    exchange_server = countIf(isNotNull(exchange.server)),
    environment = countIf(isNotNull(environment)),
    mailbox_name = countIf(isNotNull(mailbox.name)),
    database_name = countIf(isNotNull(database.name))

timeseries {
  sizeBytes = max(custom.exchange.mailbox.total_item_size_bytes, scalar: true),
  deletedBytes = max(custom.exchange.mailbox.total_deleted_item_size_bytes, scalar: true),
  items = max(custom.exchange.mailbox.item_count, scalar: true),
  lastLogonSeconds = max(custom.exchange.mailbox.last_logon_age_seconds, scalar: true)
}, by: {exchange.server, mailbox.name, database.name}, from: now() - 2h
| fieldsAdd sizeGB = round(sizeBytes / 1073741824, decimals: 2),
            deletedGB = round(deletedBytes / 1073741824, decimals: 2),
            daysSinceLogon = round(lastLogonSeconds / 86400, decimals: 1)
| sort sizeBytes desc
| limit 50
| fields exchange.server, mailbox.name, database.name, sizeGB, deletedGB, items, daysSinceLogon

sections.title: Mailboxes at or over a storage limit (empty is good)

input.value:
timeseries over = max(custom.exchange.mailbox.over_limit, scalar: true),
  by: {exchange.server, mailbox.name, database.name, storage_limit_status}, from: now() - 2h
| filter over == 1
| sort storage_limit_status asc, mailbox.name asc

timeseries {
  mailboxes = max(custom.exchange.database.mailbox_count, scalar: true),
  sizeBytes = max(custom.exchange.database.mailbox_total_size_bytes, scalar: true),
  items = max(custom.exchange.database.mailbox_total_item_count, scalar: true)
}, by: {exchange.server, database.name}, from: now() - 2h
| fieldsAdd sizeGB = round(sizeBytes / 1073741824, decimals: 2)
| sort sizeBytes desc
| fields exchange.server, database.name, mailboxes, sizeGB, items

sections.title: Mailbox collector: mailboxes scanned and run time

input.value:
timeseries {
  success = min(custom.exchange.mailbox.collector.success, scalar: true),
  scanned = max(custom.exchange.mailbox.collector.mailboxes_scanned, scalar: true),
  durationMs = max(custom.exchange.mailbox.collector.duration_ms, scalar: true)
}, by: {exchange.server, environment}, from: now() - 2h
| fieldsAdd durationSeconds = round(durationMs / 1000, decimals: 1)
| fields exchange.server, environment, success, scanned, durationSeconds

sections.title: Mailbox collector success per server (1 = ok, one point per run)

input.value: timeseries success = max(custom.exchange.mailbox.collector.success), by: {exchange.server}, from: now() - 12h, interval: 30m
